::: {.aging-widget}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof aging_controls = {
  const control = html`<div class="aging-controls">
    <label>
      <span>t</span>
      <input name="time" type="range" min="0" max="5" step="0.05" value="3">
      <output></output>
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>a′</span>
      <input name="aprime" type="range" min="0" max="3" step="0.1" value="1">
      <output></output>
    </label>
  </div>`;

  const time = control.querySelector("[name='time']");
  const aprime = control.querySelector("[name='aprime']");
  const timeOut = time.nextElementSibling;
  const aprimeOut = aprime.nextElementSibling;

  function update(dispatch = true) {
    control.value = {
      time: Number(time.value),
      aprime: Number(aprime.value)
    };
    timeOut.textContent = `${Number(time.value).toFixed(2)} лет`;
    aprimeOut.textContent = `${Number(aprime.value).toFixed(1)} год⁻¹`;
    if (dispatch) control.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  }

  time.addEventListener("input", () => update());
  aprime.addEventListener("input", () => update());
  update(false);
  return control;
}
```

//| echo: false
{
  const {time, aprime} = aging_controls;
  const tauAt = (u) => aprime === 0 ? u : Math.asinh(aprime * u) / aprime;
  const gammaAt = (u) => Math.sqrt(1 + (aprime * u) ** 2);
  const velocityAt = (u) => aprime === 0 ? 0 : aprime * u / gammaAt(u);
  const tau = tauAt(time);
  const delta = time - tau;
  const ratio = time === 0 ? 1 : tau / time;
  const tMax = 5;
  const yMax = 5;

  const ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const width = 900;
  const height = 390;
  const plotLeft = 58;
  const plotTop = 26;
  const plotWidth = 500;
  const plotHeight = 300;
  const panelLeft = 596;

  const sx = (x) => plotLeft + x / tMax * plotWidth;
  const sy = (y) => plotTop + (yMax - y) / yMax * plotHeight;
  const f = (x) => Math.abs(x) < 1e-9 ? "0.00" : x.toFixed(2);
  const linePath = (fn, steps = 180) => {
    let d = "";
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const x = tMax * i / steps;
      const y = fn(x);
      d += `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${sx(x)} ${sy(y)} `;
    }
    return d;
  };

  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "aging-board";

  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.textContent = `
    .aging-controls { display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0 0 0.3rem; }
    .aging-controls label { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.8rem 12rem 5.2rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; margin: 0; color: #f2f2f2; font-size: 0.46em; }
    .aging-controls input[type="range"] { width: 12rem; accent-color: #58a6ff; }
    .aging-controls output { min-width: 5.2rem; padding: 0.08rem 0.25rem; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 6px; background: #101722; color: #f2f2f2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }
    .aging-board { width: min(100%, 900px); margin: 0 auto; }
    .aging-board svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
  `;
  wrap.append(style);

  const svg = document.createElementNS(ns, "svg");
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
  svg.setAttribute("role", "img");
  svg.setAttribute("aria-label", "Сравнение лабораторного и собственного времени ускоренного наблюдателя");
  wrap.append(svg);

  function add(name, attrs = {}, parent = svg) {
    const node = document.createElementNS(ns, name);
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(attrs)) {
      if (key === "text") {
        node.textContent = value;
      } else {
        node.setAttribute(key, value);
      }
    }
    parent.append(node);
    return node;
  }

  const defs = add("defs");
  const marker = add("marker", {
    id: "aging-arrow",
    markerWidth: "8",
    markerHeight: "8",
    refX: "6",
    refY: "4",
    orient: "auto",
    markerUnits: "strokeWidth"
  }, defs);
  add("path", {d: "M 0 0 L 8 4 L 0 8 Z", fill: "#d7dde8"}, marker);

  add("rect", {x: "0", y: "0", width, height, rx: "12", fill: "#070a0f", stroke: "#243244"});
  add("rect", {x: plotLeft, y: plotTop, width: plotWidth, height: plotHeight, fill: "#0b111b", stroke: "#303b4f", "stroke-width": "1.2"});

  for (let tick = 0; tick <= 5; tick++) {
    add("line", {x1: sx(tick), y1: sy(0), x2: sx(tick), y2: sy(5), stroke: "#1e2a3b", "stroke-width": "1"});
    add("line", {x1: sx(0), y1: sy(tick), x2: sx(5), y2: sy(tick), stroke: "#1e2a3b", "stroke-width": "1"});
    add("text", {x: sx(tick), y: sy(0) + 24, fill: "#9fb0c7", "font-size": "13", "text-anchor": "middle", text: `${tick}`});
    add("text", {x: sx(0) - 12, y: sy(tick) + 5, fill: "#9fb0c7", "font-size": "13", "text-anchor": "end", text: `${tick}`});
  }

  add("line", {x1: sx(0), y1: sy(0), x2: sx(5.08), y2: sy(0), stroke: "#d7dde8", "stroke-width": "1.6", "marker-end": "url(#aging-arrow)"});
  add("line", {x1: sx(0), y1: sy(0), x2: sx(0), y2: sy(5.08), stroke: "#d7dde8", "stroke-width": "1.6", "marker-end": "url(#aging-arrow)"});
  add("text", {x: sx(5.0), y: sy(0) + 46, fill: "#d7dde8", "font-size": "16", "text-anchor": "end", text: "t, годы"});
  add("text", {x: sx(0) + 10, y: sy(5.0) - 10, fill: "#d7dde8", "font-size": "16", text: "τ, годы"});

  add("path", {
    d: linePath((u) => u),
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "#ffb86c",
    "stroke-width": "2.5",
    "stroke-dasharray": "8 7"
  });
  add("path", {
    d: linePath(tauAt),
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "#58a6ff",
    "stroke-width": "4"
  });

  if (time > 0) {
    add("line", {
      x1: sx(time),
      y1: sy(tau),
      x2: sx(time),
      y2: sy(time),
      stroke: "#ff5d73",
      "stroke-width": "5",
      opacity: "0.78"
    });
  }
  add("line", {x1: sx(time), y1: sy(0), x2: sx(time), y2: sy(time), stroke: "#9fb0c7", "stroke-width": "1.4", "stroke-dasharray": "5 6", opacity: "0.8"});
  add("circle", {cx: sx(time), cy: sy(tau), r: "7", fill: "#58a6ff", stroke: "#ffffff", "stroke-width": "2"});
  add("circle", {cx: sx(time), cy: sy(time), r: "5.5", fill: "#ffb86c", stroke: "#ffffff", "stroke-width": "1.6"});
  add("text", {x: sx(2.45), y: sy(tauAt(2.45)) - 14, fill: "#58a6ff", "font-size": "16", text: "τ(t) = arsinh(a′t)/a′"});
  add("text", {x: sx(3.15), y: sy(3.15) - 10, fill: "#ffb86c", "font-size": "16", text: "τ = t"});
  add("text", {x: sx(time) + 10, y: sy((time + tau) / 2), fill: "#ff9fb0", "font-size": "16", text: "t − τ"});

  add("rect", {x: panelLeft, y: "34", width: "260", height: "280", rx: "10", fill: "#101722", stroke: "#2b3a50"});
  add("text", {x: panelLeft + 20, y: "70", fill: "#ffffff", "font-size": "21", "font-weight": "700", text: "Эффект старения"});
  add("text", {x: panelLeft + 20, y: "110", fill: "#d7dde8", "font-size": "16", text: `лабораторное t = ${f(time)} лет`});
  add("text", {x: panelLeft + 20, y: "138", fill: "#58a6ff", "font-size": "16", text: `собственное τ = ${f(tau)} лет`});
  add("text", {x: panelLeft + 20, y: "166", fill: "#ff9fb0", "font-size": "16", text: `отставание t − τ = ${f(delta)} лет`});
  add("text", {x: panelLeft + 20, y: "204", fill: "#d7dde8", "font-size": "16", text: `τ/t = ${f(ratio)}`});
  add("text", {x: panelLeft + 20, y: "232", fill: "#d7dde8", "font-size": "16", text: `v(t) = ${f(velocityAt(time))}`});
  add("text", {x: panelLeft + 20, y: "270", fill: "#9fb0c7", "font-size": "14", text: "При a′ = 0 синяя кривая"});
  add("text", {x: panelLeft + 20, y: "291", fill: "#9fb0c7", "font-size": "14", text: "совпадает с инерциальной."});

  add("text", {x: plotLeft, y: "372", fill: "#9fb0c7", "font-size": "14", text: "Чем больше a′t, тем медленнее накапливается собственное время ускоренного наблюдателя."});

  return wrap;
}
